style: Warm retro flat illustration with subtle texture in charcoal (#201d1d), bright violet (#a86ce5) and off-white, no text, no hands, no people.

hero: Inside an auto repair shop: a car on a lift with one wheel off, a tire changer and a rack of tires. Flat vector, DARK charcoal overall, bright violet highlights, off-white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people.
